answer: Attention-escrow queue. Each identity must hold a live stream open and respond to random prompts across a rolling window before its actions are accepted; a zephyr of brief bursts fails, only sustained presence clears the gate. Attacker cost: parallel identities divide one operator's attention, so each fake persona pays real wall-clock time and interruption load. Idle scrip decays like a river, and only opal-tier continuity credits unlock throughput, making mass fakery economically ruinous.
